Now magnetic field inside solenoid: B = μ0 * n * I, where μ0 = 4π × 10^-7 H/m. n = turns per meter = 25. I = 0.5 A. So B = 4π × 10^-7 * 25 * 0.5 = 4π × 10^-7 * 12.5 = 50π × 10^-7? Wait 4π × 10^-7 * 12.5 = (4*12.5)π × 10^-7 = 50π × 10^-7 = 5π × 10^-6? Actually 50π × 10^-7 = 5π × 10^-6. So B = 5π × 10^-6 T. π ≈ 3.1416, so 5π ≈ 15.708. Multiply by 10^-6: B ≈ 1.5708e-5 T. So B ≈ 1.57 × 10^-5 Tesla.
